_note: Proposal only - nothing was applied. Values read 2026-09-23/24 from the user's files. 'current' = value on disk, 'suggested' = lag/load-oriented value for a 16 GB RAM / RTX 4050 6 GB laptop with a very large CC library.

ConfigOverride/GraphicsRules.sgr.current: Simp4Sims 'SGR Full 19-08-2021' standalone rules (49,084 bytes, mtime 2025-12-11); does not include SimpsSetters.sgr/MySetters.sgr nor stock Ts4CommonRules.sgr
ConfigOverride/GraphicsRules.sgr.suggested: move ConfigOverride\GraphicsRules.sgr (and the orphaned MySetters.sgr / SimpsSetters.sgr) out of ConfigOverride so the stock E:\The Sims 4\Game\Bin\GraphicsRules.sgr is used; keep a backup copy

simquality.why: VeryHigh + override = 2048px sim textures at every LOD; High (stock) = 1024/512/256/128

useuncompressedtextures.why: uncompressed sim textures cost VRAM/RAM on a 6 GB GPU / 16 GB RAM machine

lightingquality.why: override VeryHigh = 5120 shadow map (stock 2048); stock High = 1024 x 3 cascades

generalreflections.why: High re-renders the scene in mirrors/water with 8-12x the stock far plane under the override

edgesmoothing.why: override writes FSAALevel 512 for High (stock 8); Low or Off is much cheaper

visualeffects.why: GPU particle density 1.0 -> 0.7, no high-detail weather

viewdistance.why: keep High only after removing the override (stock far clip 1000/1500 m vs override 9999 m); set 1 (Low) if open-world lag persists

terrainquality.why: minor; override forces TerrainLODBoost 6 on every level

objectquality.why: keep High after override removal (stock LOD bias 0.6666, texture threshold 1024); drop to 2 if VRAM stutter

sceneresolution.why: native; 2 (= 25/32 scale) is the fallback if GPU-bound

frameratelimit.why: vsync is off; a 240 cap lets menus/CAS/loading screens run the laptop GPU flat out (heat, shared power budget)

fullscreen.why: both fullscreen=1 and windowedfullscreen=1 are set; the stock default is both 0

maxprotectedsims.why: option maps to MaxProtectedSimCount 150 (1) vs 80 (0) in the rules files; fewer protected sims = more culling = smaller world population

onlineaccess.why: optional; ConnectionStatus.txt shows the client stuck in STATE_CONNECTING / kOnlineServicesTemporarilyUnavailable

enableasyncculling.why: async culling is already on; nothing more to enable

window_peeping_npcs_flag / creep_npc_swi.why: each spawns extra NPCs (spawn chance 0.35 / 0.3) and window_peeping_create_premade_sims=1 adds sims to the save
